summary: Jersey Central Power & Light filed an 8-K announcing the filing of an S-4 registration statement to recast audited financial information due to a change in segment reporting, effective January 1, 2026. The company now reports as a single integrated business, eliminating the prior Distribution and Transmission segments. This recast updates segment data in the 2025 Form 10-K but does not amend any financial statements or constitute a special situation event. No deal, activist campaign, or strategic review is involved.
